title: Extract of Beef
instructions: Is guaranteed by the manufacturers to be a strictly pure essence of fresh, lean beef. It is especially adapted for the sick-room, where its use is recommended on account of its purity and strength.
If you cannot procure it from your druggist or grocer, address the manufacturers or any of their branch houses.
Full weight in every bottle guaranteed. An illustration of bottle of Morrell's Fluid Beef.
